caliber_from_disk.per_scene_ratio_definition: mean_i (payload_B1(i) / payload_B0(i)); this is what Phase-10.1 mean_ratio stored

snapshot_rule: Scan B1 episodes in scenario order 8-15. Inside each episode scan increasing time_step, then UAV index 0..M-1. Accept a snapshot at the start of a step iff: target not idle, target in 0..K-1, target queue > 0, UAV currently in service range, remaining_hold > 0, episode not terminated. Take at most MAX_PER_SCENARIO per scenario and stop at MAX_SNAPSHOTS. Do not filter by later C1/C2 payoff.
